{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Select only the two columns of interest
flippervsbody = penguins[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']]

# Drop rows with any missing values in these two columns
complete_cases = flippervsbody.dropna()

# Compute the Pearson correlation
pearson_corr = complete_cases['flipper_length_mm'].corr(complete_cases['body_mass_g'])

pearson_corr"}
